integrity: The complete continuous-domain proof and equality classification are analytical; finite checks are corroborative. Publication-priority search is incomplete and independent verification has not been performed.
limitations: The spatial theorem concerns m=3 or m=4 equally weighted unnormalized Dirichlet sine modes. The Fisher interpretation assumes independent Gaussian resolved-modal errors of common positive variance; no claim for raw coupled sensing, general demixing noise, or m>=5.
title: Exact two-site maximin modal-energy design for three and four Dirichlet harmonics
